title: The Mg II record changes the fitted Cycle 25 radio offset on the same 43 months
abstract: We test the Cycle 25 activity-index change with one ultraviolet instrument across both cycles. On the same 31 Cycle 24 and 12 Cycle 25 months, F10.7 changes by +8.62% at fixed Aura/OMI Mg II and -0.23% at fixed Bremen Mg II. Conditional paired block intervals are +5.42 to +11.76% and -3.15 to +2.14%. The ratio of fitted cycle factors is 1.0887 (1.0706 to 1.1102). A phase term retains the reference difference but weakens the absolute radio increase. Sunspot number changes by +4.93% against OMI and -11.80% against Bremen. At fixed HMI area, OMI Mg II and Ca II H and K have positive point estimates, but all main intervals include zero. Their detection depends on the phase model. The Mg II record therefore changes the inferred radio and spot response. This result does not identify instrument drift or a solar cause. Different bandpasses, few late months and calibration error limit inference. Code, aggregate results, figures, exact hashes and external retrieval instructions are included.

display.caption: The same months give different cycle offsets with OMI and Bremen Mg II. Bars show conditional paired case-block intervals.
